volume.methodology: Derived from parsed Solana token balance deltas across observed confirmed transactions on the target mint and Meteora pool.
limitations: Bounded by RPC transaction history depth (scanned recent sample, not all-time genesis).
Classifications depend on observed SOL/token balance deltas and Swap log statements.
Observed market volume does NOT necessarily equal Hooked internal Chapter accounting volume (which may only count qualifying buys, apply graduated caps, or measure in SOL/USD).
